scripts.format: npm --workspace @praxisai/web run format && uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @praxisai/web run lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @praxisai/api-client run build && npm --workspace @praxisai/web run typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/app
scripts.test: npm --workspace @praxisai/web run test && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.build: npm --workspace @praxisai/api-client run build && npm --workspace @praxisai/web run build
scripts.openapi: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --workspace @praxisai/api-client run generate && npm --workspace @praxisai/api-client run build
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:current: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini current
scripts.db:check: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini check
scripts.setup: npm install && uv sync --project apps/api && npm run db:migrate && npm run openapi
